label: General improvements plus held-out cases
notes: Three general improvements (an unreachable graph with no snapshot now degrades to answering without stored facts instead of failing the question; a suspected false premise tells the drafter to state the correct fact; the report retries network errors and starts each section from clean state so one section's cache cannot leak into the next) and, to check for overfitting, new held-out cases written before any result was seen and never tuned on: 13 attack cases (10 attacks, 3 controls) and 8 live questions. Development and held-out results are reported separately.
